newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Singapore rubber market is closed from Friday, February 6 to Monday, February 10 for the Chinese Lunar New Year and Muslim Hari Raya Puasa holidays.
It will reopen on Tuesday, February 11.
On Wednesday, March RSS3 rose 1.50 cents to 121.50 U.S. cents a kg.
May RSS3 rose three cents to 175.75 Singapore cents (US$1.25) a kg
April TSR20 was indicated AT 169.00 Singapore cents (US$1.20) a kg compared with Tuesday's settlement of 167.50 cents. (US$1-S$1.41) - P. Theseira (65-870-3085)
